resultados.refuerzo: Starting a second account is not the fix; the advice is to keep the number and call service.
Customer service contacts you before you continue, so you can send the missing document in time.
Only after delivery is too late; the contact comes before you continue.
The text does say when they contact you; the answer is before continuing.
The tracking number lets you follow the progress of the shipment.
The tracking number does not change a password; it only follows the shipment.
A tracking number is not proof of identity; it only follows the shipment.
A continuación means next, introducing the next step: attach a copy of the receipt.
Sin embargo means however, a contrast; the sentence gives a next step, not a contrast.
Aunque means although, a concession; the sentence needs a connector that gives a sequence.
Esa petición points back to the request for the tap and the cupboard, the noun just mentioned.
Planting tomatoes is not what petición refers to; it points back to the request.
The empty plot is mentioned, but esa petición points to the request itself.
Por ello means for this reason, so it introduces a result of the information before.
Por ello introduces a result, not a contrast; a contrast would use pero or sin embargo.
Por ello is not a time sequence; it links a result to the previous information.
The text states that the project does not produce enough food for the whole neighbourhood.
Having no school participants is not the limitation; the stated limit is the amount of food.
Being approved for expansion is a positive status, not a limitation of the project.
A pesar de means despite; it introduces a fact that does not stop people from joining.
Por ello means for this reason, a result; the sentence needs a concession, despite.
Porque means because, a cause; the sentence needs a concession, like despite.
The praise is ironic because the review points out the lack of seating.
Many comfortable benches would make the praise sincere, not ironic; the review complains about seating.
Lighting is not the topic of the irony; the irony is about the lack of seating.
The reviewer thinks the exhibition is worth visiting, even with the inconvenient route.
Having no useful material contradicts the review's overall view that the exhibition is worthwhile.
The review does give an opinion; the overall view is clear, even with criticism.
One bench in three rooms is a concrete detail that backs up the complaint.
Photographs are a neutral detail, not a flaw that supports the criticism.
Clear explanations are praise; they do not support the criticism in the review.
Pero marks the contrast: the phrase seems like praise, but the context shows criticism.
Porque means because, a cause; the sentence needs a contrast, not a reason.
Por ejemplo introduces an example; the sentence needs a contrast, so it does not fit.
